## Checklist

- [ ] I read global-constraints.md before coding.
- [ ] I used the correct room file for this task (partner-feedback, knowledge-base, src, or prisma).
- [ ] Staff-facing UI text stays at a simple reading level.
- [ ] I did not add banned clinical/diagnostic jargon in staff-facing UI files.
- [ ] I did not log PHI in console output or put PHI in URLs.
- [ ] I used soft delete patterns where required.
- [ ] I added or updated audit logging on sensitive write actions.
- [ ] `npm run policy-check` passes locally.
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run type-check` pass locally.
